{"query":"Rewrite `/Users/bmoir/Desktop/applyos/applyOS/db/schema.ts` to expand the ApplyOS schema for the PRD while KEEP all existing tables and columns (additive only — do not remove existing fields).

Requirements:
1. Keep existing enums and tables exactly (users, userProfiles, resumes, companies, jobSources, jobs, resumeVersions, applications, coverLetters, emailMessages, workflowRuns, agentEvents) and their relations.
2. ADD these enums:
   - kanbanStageEnum: applied, follow_up_needed, waiting_to_hear_back, interview_scheduled, interview_completed, waiting_for_offer, offer_pending, rejected_closed, hired
   - approvalStatusEnum: pending, approved, rejected, expired, cancelled
   - approvalActionTypeEnum: external_submit, send_email, create_calendar_event, apply_email_status, publish_document
   - emailDirectionEnum: inbound, outbound
   - tribeSlugEnum or just use varchar for tribe slugs
3. Extend `users` with optional: emailSubdomain (varchar unique), hiredAt (timestamp), communityUnlockedAt (timestamp)
4. Extend `userProfiles` with optional: linkedinUrl, nonNegotiables (jsonb string[]), scorecardData (jsonb), profileEmbedding (vector 768), embeddingModel, embeddingPooling, embeddingContentHash, embeddedAt, onboardingStep (varchar)
5. Extend `jobs` with optional: jobEmbedding (vector 768), embeddingModel, embeddingPooling, embeddingContentHash, embeddedAt, matchBadges (jsonb string[]), semanticScore (integer), cosineDistance (real/double — use real from drizzle)
6. Extend `applications` with optional: kanbanStage (kanbanStageEnum, default applied), hiredAt
7. Extend `emailMessages` with optional: threadId, messageId (unique-ish), direction, draftBodyText, draftSubject, sendApprovedAt, sentAt, providerMessageId, attachmentMeta (jsonb)
8. ADD new tables:
   - approvalRequests: id, userId, actionType, status, resourceType, resourceId, payload jsonb, rationale text, decidedAt, decidedByUserId, expiresAt, timestamps + indexes by user+status
   - emailIdentities: id, userId unique, subdomain unique, displayAddress, isActive, timestamps
   - emailThreads: id, userId, applicationId nullable, subject, lastMessageAt, timestamps
   - calendarEvents: id, userId, applicationId, title, startsAt, endsAt, location, icsContent, approvalRequestId, externalEventId, timestamps
   - applicationPackets: id, userId, jobId, applicationId nullable, resumeVersionId nullable, coverLetterId nullable, promptInstructions text, status varchar, timestamps
   - tribes: id, slug unique, name, description, timestamps
   - tribeMemberships: id, tribeId, userId, role varchar default member, joinedAt, unique(tribeId,userId)
   - tribePosts: id, tribeId, authorUserId, title, bodyMarkdown, timestamps + indexes
   - tribePostReplies: id, postId, authorUserId, bodyMarkdown, timestamps
   - careerMilestones: id, userId, planType varchar (e.g. 30_60_90), title, contentMarkdown, status, approvalRequestId nullable, timestamps
   - careerAchievements: id, userId, title, description, achievedAt, evidenceUrl, timestamps
   - compensationEntries: id, userId, title, amountCents int, currency, effectiveAt, notes, timestamps
   - mentorshipOffers: id, userId, tribeId nullable, title, description, isActive, timestamps
   - referralRequests: id, requesterUserId, helperUserId nullable, companyName, roleTitle, status, notes, timestamps

9. Import `vector` from drizzle-orm/pg-core. Use `vector("profile_embedding", { dimensions: 768 })`.
10. Import `real` if needed for cosineDistance storage.
11. Update relations for all new tables and extend usersRelations etc.
12. Expand agentEventTypeEnum values if needed: add profile_ingest, embed_job, embed_profile, prepare_application, send_email, create_calendar_event, tribe_unlock, milestone_generate — but PostgreSQL enums can't easily add in drizzle without migration; ADD new values to the TypeScript enum definition (migration SQL will alter type).

Write the COMPLETE file. Do not leave placeholders. Keep TypeScript strict, no `any`."}
